exit_gate_note: The release is reconstructible and verifiable from the repository alone: the frozen contract surface, the archived release surface, the measured gate verdicts, the rubric map and the decision register are all in the tree, and `reconstruct.commands` lists the exact steps.
git_sha_note: the commit the working tree was based on when the archive was generated (the archive is written before the commit that carries it); the frozen digest is the commit-independent anchor.

limitations.note: The archive records internal verification results only. It is not a jury score and never claims one (official_score_claimed: false).

reconstruct.note: Run in this order from a clean checkout of the release tag; every command is offline, stdlib-only and deterministic.
